description: Offline yt-dlp-style playlist JSON accepted by the yt-dlp-json adapter. This is provider-specific input, not a generic Automation core schema.
notes: When _type is present it must equal playlist.
Null entries are skipped and do not consume ordinals.
The adapter preserves repeated URLs; deduplication belongs to the reusable core.
Cookies, tokens, browser profiles, and private account state must never appear in tracked fixtures.
